_comment: Hand-entered Trophy Room content. This is the source of truth and lives in the repo rather than on the data branch, so a change is reviewed like code and survives a data-branch rebuild; the pipeline copies it into data/kp/trophy/curated.json. Nothing renders on the deployed site until its status is "approved" — drafts appear only on a local dev server. `source` is "confirmed" when there is a record and "reported" when somebody remembers it, and the page says which. A plaque may cite a team-week in `evidence`, and the pipeline fails the build if the cited number does not match the stored record, so a hand-written plaque cannot carry a wrong statistic. Owner ids come from owners.json.

plaques.sourceNote: Verified against the stored team-week; the pipeline re-checks the figure on every build.
plaques.title: Twenty home runs in a championship week
plaques.description: Twenty home runs in the second week of the 2026 championship bracket. It is the most any team has hit in a championship-bracket week, level with joey in week 23 of 2017, and no other team in that week of 2026 reached fourteen.
